objective: Close the two gaps the work register leaves a person to fill by hand. First: when a campaign a workstream points at opens a pull request, nothing records that pull request against the workstream — a person has to notice it and link it, so the register says PR_READY only when somebody remembered, and says IN_PROGRESS about work that is actually waiting on a review. Second: the register cannot say `MERGED`, `DEPLOYED` or `VERIFIED_LIVE` about anything without a person typing an attestation, because Brain holds no forge credential and refuses to read a URL as a merge — which is right, and leaves the whole right-hand half of the owner's question 'what actually shipped?' answerable only by hand.
expectedOutcome: A workstream pointing at a campaign that has opened a pull request shows that pull request among its readings without anybody linking it, attested by the campaign rather than by a person. And a workstream whose pull request has merged reads MERGED, from evidence Brain recorded when it saw the merge rather than from a sentence somebody typed — with the same refusal as today for anything nobody has attested to.
nonGoals: Giving Brain a forge credential, or having it poll GitHub. The attestation must come from something that already observes the repository on Brain's behalf, and Brain holding no repository credential is a property §27 states and this must not change.
Storing a state column on workstreams. The state stays derived on the read path; what this adds is evidence for the derivation to read.
Composing an intent or a purpose for anything. Filing a workstream stays a person's decision.
Reading a bare URL as a merge. An unattested pull request must still contribute nothing.

acceptanceConditions.statement: A campaign that reaches COMPLETE with a pull request url records a PULL_REQUEST link, attested by the campaign, on every live workstream that points at that campaign — and records exactly one however many times the writeback runs.
A workstream with no campaign, or with a campaign that has no pull request, is untouched: nothing is linked and its derived state does not move.
A pull request link carrying no attestation still contributes no state, and the existing test asserting that still passes unchanged.

The merge attestation is recorded from an observation Brain actually made, and the code path that records it names where the observation came from. Nothing in it reads a URL, a title or a branch name as evidence of a merge.
Every new behaviour has a test beside it, and at least one of them is run against a neutered version of the guard it covers to confirm it fails first.

rollbackRequirement: Discard the branch. Nothing outside server/services/register, server/services/factory/writeback.ts, server/repos/register.ts and the two named suites is touched, and the register holds no state column to migrate back.
